title: Nested Speculative Execution Attacks via Runahead
relevance: Comprehensive analysis of runahead execution mechanics. While focused on security, provides deep understanding of how runahead generates prefetches and the performance benefits it provides, which directly inform the parsing prefetch strategy.

title: Speculative Decoding via Hybrid Drafting and Rollback-Aware Branch Parallelism (SpecBranch)
relevance: Draws inspiration from CPU branch prediction for LLM speculative decoding. The conceptual bridge from hardware speculation to software speculation parallels our application to parsing.

title: On-Demand JSON: A Better Way to Parse Documents?
relevance: The On-Demand parser's sequential tape traversal creates natural prefetch opportunities. The runahead concept adds systematic prefetching to this existing architecture.
